Antaño solo en la radio o en la tele, pero ahora también puedes encontrártelos en redes sociales. ¿El problema? Así que en China han ido un paso más allá y pasan de los anuncios: se montan su propio microdrama, un formato que causa furor en el país. Que viva el microdrama . item.description: US immigration authorities are set to intensify their review of H-1B visa records by utilizing artificial intelligence technology. This will allow them to detect any mismatches between the addresses reported and the actual worksite locations. item.title: Eating late at night linked to up to 30% higher risk of liver disease, study finds
item.description: Recent research emphasizes the concerning link between late-night eating and liver diseases. A comprehensive study involving nearly 200,000 participants over a median span of 16 years found that those who dined late displayed increased cases of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and cirrhosis. The underlying mechanisms linking meal timing to liver health are still not well understood, warranting further exploration into how eating habits impact liver well-being. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
